items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I had a wonderful bass player called Stillman ... it was a hell of a band.

ctx.x: And, he also played fluegal- horn. I had a wonderful bass player called Stillman

and he played trumpet as well as the bass-- and, uh, I had Don Owens on the piano; I said Abe Lincoln, and myself-- it was a hell of a band. We used to rehearse in my living room and I want to tell you, it was fantastic. We couldn't give it away; you couldn't give it away.
